subject: tailwindcss 3 holds postcss-selector-parser on 6.x, inside GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf, and only Tailwind 4 releases it
activeForm: Migrating the customer dashboard to Tailwind 4

origin.evidence: cd frontend && npm audit  # postcss-selector-parser <7.1.6, via tailwindcss and postcss-nested

work_items: Card #NEW: migrate frontend/ to Tailwind 4 (config, tailwindcss-animate, postcss plugin, globals.css) and verify the customer dashboard visually

description:
Found by card #15. GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (postcss-selector-parser < 7.1.6, medium, published 2026-10-05) is reported by npm audit in frontend/ and has no Dependabot record yet; it will open as an alert. tailwindcss 3.4.19, the last 3.x, and postcss-nested 6 require postcss-selector-parser 6.x, so no update inside Tailwind 3 reaches 7.1.6. Tailwind 4 has no dependencies.

The migration also removes one of the two paths to braces (#226 on card #15, no patched release); the other runs through @next/eslint-plugin-next's exact fast-glob 3.3.1 pin, so this card alone does not clear #226.

Scope: tailwind.config.ts (82 lines, shadcn-style theme), the tailwindcss-animate plugin, postcss.config.js, src/app/globals.css, and classes across 88 component files. No gate checks the result visually; that check is part of the work.
